description: integrations.sh is a registry that catalogs developer and agent integration surfaces across many services, including REST/OpenAPI APIs, GraphQL endpoints, MCP servers, and CLIs. It also provides tools to detect and discover what programmatic surfaces a domain exposes.
summary: integrations.sh exposes three documented integration surfaces on its own domain: a REST API at `https://integrations.sh/api`, a streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://integrations.sh/mcp`, and an `integrations` CLI; no credentials or explicit public/no-auth confirmation are documented for any of them.
